essential_points.text: Refrigerates cooked rice within one hour of cooking
Eats refrigerated rice within one day
Reheats rice until steaming hot all the way through
Does not reheat rice more than once

must_not.text: Says cooked rice is safe to leave at room temperature overnight

essential_points.text: Changes the email password now
Changes the password on other accounts that used the same password
Turns on two-factor authentication
Checks recovery phone number, recovery email and forwarding rules

must_not.text: Advises reusing one new password across all accounts

essential_points.text: Seeks medical assessment if unable to bear weight, severe pain or deformity
Rest, ice wrapped in a cloth, compression bandage and elevation
Paracetamol for pain

must_not.text: Advises playing on through severe pain

essential_points.text: Carries enough drinking water for the whole hike
Tells someone the route and expected return
Sun protection such as a hat and sunscreen
Map and a charged phone

must_not.text: Says water is unnecessary for a short hike
